intro.text: An Azish thief in Huqin's crew, which plans to rob the Bronze Palace in Azimir.

items.text: During the attempt on the Bronze Palace in 1173, Maxin and Tigzikk dressed as scribes to mingle with the officials gathered in the gardens for the choosing of a new Prime Aqasix. They were lookouts, ready to whistle a warning to the rest of the crew if anything went wrong. It isn't clear whether they got away with Huqin when the job fell apart.

appearance.text: Like the rest of Huqin's crew apart from Lift, he is Azish, with dark hair and dark skin.

personality.text: He is hopeful that the crew can pull off the heist.
